command(python -c "
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

ref_path = Path(r'C:\Users\Reaticle\.gemini\config\templates\reference-gbk.docx')
with zipfile.ZipFile(ref_path) as z:
    print('Zip files in reference-gbk.docx:', z.namelist())
    styles_xml = z.read('word/styles.xml')
    tree = ET.fromstring(styles_xml)
    w_ns = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'
    ns = {'w': w_ns}
    for s in tree.findall('w:style', ns):
        sid = s.attrib.get(f'{{{w_ns}}}styleId')
        if sid in ['Heading1', 'Heading2', 'Heading3', 'Heading4', 'Normal', 'BodyText', 'FirstParagraph']:
            name = s.find('w:name', ns)
            name_val = name.attrib.get(f'{{{w_ns}}}val') if name is not None else ''
            pPr = s.find('w:pPr', ns)
            rPr = s.find('w:rPr', ns)
            sz = rPr.find('w:sz', ns).attrib.get(f'{{{w_ns}}}val') if rPr is not None and rPr.find('w:sz', ns) is not None else 'None'
            fonts = rPr.find('w:rFonts', ns).attrib if rPr is not None and rPr.find('w:rFonts', ns) is not None else {}
            numPr = pPr.find('w:numPr', ns) if pPr is not None else None
            ind = pPr.find('w:ind', ns).attrib if pPr is not None and pPr.find('w:ind', ns) is not None else {}
            sp = pPr.find('w:spacing', ns).attrib if pPr is not None and pPr.find('w:spacing', ns) is not None else {}
            jc = pPr.find('w:jc', ns).attrib if pPr is not None and pPr.find('w:jc', ns) is not None else {}
            print(f'StyleId={sid:15} Name={name_val:15} sz={sz:4} eastAsia={fonts.get(f\"{{{w_ns}}}eastAsia\", \"\"):12} ind={str(ind):25} sp={str(sp):35} numPr={numPr is not None}')
")
